text:
name: T16 discovery census (diagnostic only)
on:
  push:
    branches: ['diag/wasm-discovery-census-20261004']
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  correctness:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 35
    env:
      CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG: '0'
      CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG: '0'
      CARGO_INCREMENTAL: '0'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683
        with: {fetch-depth: 0}
      - run: git fetch origin main:refs/remotes/origin/main
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@1.95.0
        with: {components: rustfmt}
      - name: Default and explicitly enabled diagnostic correctness
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cargo fmt --all -- --check
          cargo test --locked -p labwired-core --features event-scheduler,t16-discovery-census --lib census_
          cargo test --locked -p labwired-core --features event-scheduler --lib cached_
          cargo test --locked -p labwired-core --no-default-features --lib cached_
          cargo test --locked -p labwired-core --features event-scheduler --lib
          cargo test --locked -p labwired-core --features event-scheduler,t16-discovery-census --lib
          cargo test --locked -p labwired-core --features t16-discovery-census --no-default-features --lib cached_
          cargo test --locked -p labwired-core --features event-scheduler,t16-discovery-census --test gpio_devices_walk_free --test gpio_devices_drive_read_only_inputs --test gpio_schedule_firmware --test bus_resident_device_port
  build:
    needs: correctness
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix: {leg: [off, a, b]}
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 60
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683
        with:
          repository: CrispStrobe/bw-board
          ref: d1f2c8ebfc5e4e76d5fc81f930588c13de13e974
          path: board
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020
        with: {node-version: '22.23.3'}
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@1.95.0
      - name: Build feature-off control or explicitly enabled diagnostic
        env: {CORE_REF: '${{ github.sha }}', LEG: '${{ matrix.leg }}'}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          args=()
          if [ "$LEG" != off ]; then args+=(--diagnostic); fi
          node .github/scripts/build-t16-census.mjs --ref "$CORE_REF" --out "$RUNNER_TEMP/out" --work-dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/t16-census-build" "${args[@]}"
          printf '%s\n' '{"type":"commonjs"}' > "$RUNNER_TEMP/out/nodejs/package.json"
      - name: Install actual guest dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update -qq
          sudo apt-get install -y -qq --no-install-recommends gcc-arm-none-eabi binutils-arm-none-eabi
          cd board
          npm ci
      - name: All 108 actual-WASM integrations including seven same-PC proofs
        working-directory: board
        env: {LABWIRED_WASM: '${{ runner.temp }}/out/nodejs'}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          node --test test/labwired-adapter.test.mjs test/labwired-bridge.test.mjs test/labwired-roundtrip.test.mjs test/pad-drive-parity.test.mjs test/labwired-firmware-only.test.mjs test/labwired-microbit-matrix.test.mjs test/labwired-input-boundary.test.mjs test/labwired-word-admission.test.mjs 2>&1 | tee ../integration.txt
          tests=$(sed -n 's/^# tests \([0-9]*\)$/\1/p' ../integration.txt | tail -1)
          fails=$(sed -n 's/^# fail \([0-9]*\)$/\1/p' ../integration.txt | tail -1)
          skips=$(sed -n 's/^# skipped \([0-9]*\)$/\1/p' ../integration.txt | tail -1)
          [ "${tests:-0}" -ge 108 ] && [ "${fails:-1}" = 0 ] && [ "${skips:-1}" = 0 ]
      - name: Five diagnostic windows, never ordinary RTx qualification
        env: {LEG: '${{ matrix.leg }}'}
        run: |
          mode=on
          if [ "$LEG" = off ]; then mode=off; fi
          node .github/scripts/capture-t16-census.mjs board "$RUNNER_TEMP/out/nodejs" "$mode"
      - name: Preserve original hashes and runner provenance
        if: always()
        run: |
          { git rev-parse HEAD; git -C board rev-parse HEAD; node --version; lscpu; } > runner.txt
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        if: always()
        with:
          name: t16-discovery-census-${{ matrix.leg }}
          path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/out
            census-*.json
            census-*.txt
            integration.txt
            runner.txt
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14
  equivalence:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093
        with: {pattern: 't16-discovery-census-*', path: captures}
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020
        with: {node-version: '22.23.3'}
      - run: node .github/scripts/verify-t16-census.mjs captures
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        if: always()
        with:
          name: t16-discovery-census-equivalence
          path: census-equivalence.json
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 14
